embeds.title: ARTICLE IX — WAIVERS, FAAB, AND ACQUISITIONS
embeds.description:
Each franchise receives **$1,000 FAAB** at the beginning of each season. FAAB does not roll over.

• $0 bids are permitted
• $1 bid increments
• Hidden bids
• No Vickrey/proxy bidding
• No first-come, first-served acquisition
• Daily processing targeted for approximately **11:00 AM ET**
• Waiver-churning protections remain enabled where available

A franchise may make up to **5 external acquisitions per normal fantasy week**. Championship-period handling follows the announced Fantrax configuration for that season.

The consolation champion receives **+$50 next-season FAAB**, giving that franchise $1,050 for that season only. The bonus expires with ordinary current-season FAAB and may be traded as current-season FAAB.
